name: printforge
label: PrintForge
tagline: Look over 3D-print files before you slice them

manifest.summary: A 3D viewer and checker for STL print files. It finds every STL under the chosen folders (by default ~/Models and ~/Downloads), shows it on a print bed you can turn, pan and zoom, and checks what a slicer cares about: watertight or not, how many separate pieces, size, volume, and which print beds it fits.

features.name: Library
features.description: Every STL under the folders, grouped by project and folder, with size, triangle count and the print scale read from a folder name such as 1-35. Search box.

features.name: 3D view
features.description: three.js view of the print on a bed with a 10 mm grid; 3/4, front, side, back and top views, turntable, wireframe, colours, and a bed outline that turns red when the print does not fit.

features.name: Print check
features.description: Watertight test (every edge shared by exactly two triangles, facing the right way), separate-piece count, inside-out warning, size, volume in cm3 (ml of resin if solid) and surface area. Cached per file.

features.name: Bed fit
features.description: Checks each bed class standing as modelled and laid over in any orientation. Beds are editable; advanced mode adds a custom bed with slider and number fields.

features.name: Folders and pictures
features.description: Advanced mode: edit the folders searched, light brightness, and save a PNG of the view. Open folder shows the file in the file manager.

manifest.data_dir: ~/.config/forge-printforge/settings.json (folders, bed, colour, mode); ~/.cache/forge-printforge/info.json (check results per file)
known_gaps: Reads STL only (no 3MF or OBJ yet).
No slicer is installed on this laptop, so there is no send-to-slicer button.
